axes.name: Original obligations and negative constraints
axes.basis: All eight exact obligations are substantively addressed. Coordinator visibility is connectivity-bounded; original/correction history, optional CSV scope, both owner authorities and all four exclusions remain binding.

axes.name: Consequential source claims and exact applicability
axes.basis: Independent primary retrieval checks the client-edit version/default and exceptions; REST versus OpenRosa operations; string identities/versions and timestamps; server receipt versus observation time; layer/export/permission conditions; CSV loading; and historical fix scope. No unsupported operational capability or product validation is represented as established.

axes.name: Useful unfamiliar discovery, alternatives, implementation/history, and opportunity breadth
axes.basis: ODK and Survey123 provide two meaningful full candidates, CouchDB a version-pinned analogy, and Kobo a further screened option. Client-edit versus separate correction form, old-field exports, XML/CSV adapter routes and the EXIF image-append exclusion are actionable discoveries. Source/commit/release history is bounded and directly relevant.

axes.name: Wrong criticism/corrections/rejections and exact plan dispositions
axes.basis: Each of the eight exact clauses and four criticisms has an explicit, evidence-based disposition. C-01/C-03 are corrected draft defects; C-02 expands research without demanding deployment or deleting the option; C-04 is a locator correction. No false material correction or unsupported scope rejection remains.

axes.name: Supported meaning preserved discovery/draft/critique/final
axes.basis: The final is a complete proposal retaining fit hypotheses, IDs/time/attachments, correction alternatives, optional import, owner choices, negatives, applicability, history and validation status. Complete inherited source records are preserved; important conditions are less prominent in final prose but remain in the carried source map. No selected workflow depends on bypassing those conditions.

axes.name: Meaningful proposed versus executed validation and oracle applicability
axes.basis: Source review/reveal plumbing are separated from unrun product checks. Interruption timing, same-ID versus different-ID records, edit order/version, bad legacy rows/reruns, and clock/EXIF scenarios discriminate the proposed mechanisms. The record model supplies expected identity/payload/photo/no-overwrite/history outcomes. Historical source and stub tests are not a current-product oracle.

plan_clauses.exact_clause: Explain how offline creation, retry, late arrival and an explicit correction become distinct coordinator-visible states.
plan_clauses.original_draft_treatment: Start with a single online form and instruct volunteers to retry failed sends. A retry is presumed to create the same record; identifiers and correction behavior are not yet specified.
plan_clauses.basis: Online-only/unspecified retry assumption replaced by local/shared lifecycle, immutable same-ID retry, distinct correction, and later client-event condition. C-01 corrected.

plan_clauses.exact_clause: Compare two usable survey products and one analogous queue/synchronization mechanism, including deployment and export tradeoffs.
plan_clauses.original_draft_treatment: ODK is the initial shortlist entry. Kobo is named for later comparison; no deployment or export evidence has been inspected.
plan_clauses.basis: ODK/Central and Survey123 fully compared; CouchDB analogy; Kobo screened. Deployment/export tradeoffs and ArcGIS Server website exception supplied.

plan_clauses.exact_clause: Bind observations to site, visit, form version and attachment identity; address device-clock uncertainty and duplicate detection.
plan_clauses.original_draft_treatment: Use the device timestamp as visit identity and filename as photo identity. The coordinator will deduplicate a weekly export manually.
plan_clauses.basis: Reject time/filename primary keys; separate site/visit/event/form-version/correction/attachment identity; report/client/server time distinguished; human duplicate investigation.

plan_clauses.exact_clause: Describe a bounded failure/release-history example relevant to reconnect or correction, and its actual applicability.
plan_clauses.original_draft_treatment: Assume a recent release resolves intermittent-network problems. No released-version or issue-chain investigation is attached.
plan_clauses.basis: Unspecified recent fix replaced by issue/commit/merged-PR/release chain, historically bounded. No current defect or exactly-once claim.

plan_clauses.exact_clause: Preserve and investigate this supported optional scope: coordinator-reviewed CSV import of legacy observations. It is an authorized option, not a mandatory feature or an established technical capability; recommend conditions, retain it when supported, and explain any evidence-based exclusion.
plan_clauses.original_draft_treatment: Retain coordinator-reviewed CSV import of legacy observations as supported owner-authorized optional scope. Support here means that the brief explicitly permits it; technical support, conditions and interoperability still need research. Do not remove it merely because the baseline route lacks it, or silently promote it to mandatory scope.
plan_clauses.basis: Authorized CSV option retained; XML/attachment and CSV Append routes investigated; lookup distinguished from import; schema/identity/rerun/photo/no-overwrite gates. No exclusion or mandatory promotion.

plan_clauses.exact_clause: Make owner decisions explicit: The field coordinator accepts duplicates for investigation; the data steward decides whether a correction replaces the current view or appears beside it. No silent automatic merge is approved.
plan_clauses.original_draft_treatment: Owner authority is reserved as follows: The field coordinator accepts duplicates for investigation; the data steward decides whether a correction replaces the current view or appears beside it. No silent automatic merge is approved. The draft has not obtained these decisions. Its tentative implementation assumptions cannot substitute for them.
plan_clauses.basis: Coordinator accepts duplicate candidates for investigation; steward chooses current view or beside. Original/history retained either way. No automatic merge or inferred owner choice.

plan_clauses.exact_clause: Preserve negative constraints: Do not require volunteers to remain online, infer precise location from photographs, change personal-device settings, or propose remote deletion of their originals.
plan_clauses.original_draft_treatment: Binding exclusions: Do not require volunteers to remain online, infer precise location from photographs, change personal-device settings, or propose remote deletion of their originals. The draft has no complete trace showing that its assumptions comply; revise the proposal wherever necessary to preserve these exclusions.
plan_clauses.basis: No continuous-online requirement, photo-location inference, personal-device setting change or remote original deletion. EXIF-derived image append excluded.

plan_clauses.exact_clause: Deliver one coherent evidence-backed research proposal covering obligations 1–8, with recommendations, source/version applicability, useful discoveries, unresolved owner inputs, and a validation table separating checks actually executed from checks merely proposed. Do not report research sources or future tests as executed product validation.
plan_clauses.original_draft_treatment: The draft currently contains no coherent evidence-backed final proposal. Its proposed demos are research/validation ideas only. A complete revision must preserve every obligation, disclose corrections and retained options, and not confuse documentation review with successful product operation.
plan_clauses.basis: Complete scoped proposal plus source map, conditions, alternatives, owner inputs and prospective validation. Research distinguished from product execution. Validation priority/oracle detail is implicit, not materially absent.

limitations.description: Central-side edits block subsequent Collect edits of that submission; Kobo web edits use the latest form and may remove old-field answers. These are compressed out of final prose but carried explicitly in the complete source map. Correction route/roles/history remain prospective owner choices, so no finalized incompatible workflow or claim of lossless Kobo edits remains.

REST existing-ID 409 differs from OpenRosa changed-XML/deleted-ID 409. Sync-off describes newly published feature layers. ArcGIS upsert is blocked with sync/changeTracking; non-upsert allocates system IDs. Safe reconciliation and the conditional no-overwrite importer do not rely on broader incorrect interpretations.

CouchDB revision leaves are not unlimited past-body retention after compaction. Kobo also offers project history logs alongside recommended external logs/comments. Candidate does not deploy CouchDB as an audit store or categorically ban Kobo; two fully compared products meet the comparison requirement.

Validation scenarios are meaningful but pass/fail cells and priorities are mostly implicit in the proposed identity/history/no-overwrite model and adoption gates. No executable prototype or live deployment was required. All product checks remain NOT_RUN.

Allowed artifacts lack raw native stage tool receipts and effective/billing telemetry. Reviser native-ID strings differ between b9d and b09d. Critic frozen artifact mtimes exceed its stage cap. These limits are separate from semantic source qualification.

unknowns.basis: Native stage events are reported in prose/summary; raw independent stage-native receipts absent from allowed package.
Request/dispatch files express intent; T3 returned routing labels do not prove effective provider options.

No complete original tool trace inspected; no unauthorized assistance established in allowed artifacts.
No product install/account/production or end-to-end execution claimed or performed.
Actual view policy, infrastructure/roles/device versions, hosting/retention terms, legacy schema/photos and optional pilot need remain inputs.
